notes.title: Add some hints and features
notes.notes:
We have received feedback from players that the previous version did not provide clear criteria for the success or failure of frauds and the rewards for mini-games. In this version, we have added such prompts, which will be displayed when players choose a victim for the first time. We also received feedback that some minigame prompts became redundant after the rules were clear. We have updated this, and the rule prompts in some minigames will now only appear during the first time playing those mini-games. Additionally, based on feedback from players who have finished the game and want to collect all achievements, we have added the "Enable Skip" feature. After completing the game, players can check this option in the settings menu to skip dialogue with previously defrauded victims after completing a fraud mini-game in completed playthroughs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179349/099a065ee64d2fd4cc362929b5830a2fdefe07fb.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Language Autoload
notes.notes: We have made an urgent update where the game's language will now automatically load from Steam upon the first launch. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Our Game Is Now On Sale!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that our indie game [b]Fraudster[/b] is now released and on sale! In the game, players take on the role of a recent university graduate who accidentally joined a fraud organization, struggling to meet daily fraud performance targets. We welcome everyone to play our game, and feel free to try out our demo as well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179349/6dd30b32ddece7334b36402ccfe0602da48b21fe.png[/img]

notes.title: Our Game Now Supports Japanese
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we have added localization of the Japanese language to our game, Japanese players can now play the game in Japanese.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179349/f43794d248c05f9800b331f1175b857f06c352ed.png[/img]

notes.title: Our Game Demo Is Released!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that our game demo is [b]now available[/b]! Feel free to download it and give it a try. If you find the demo interesting—or even just not too bad—please consider [b]adding our game to your wishlist![/b] This is very important for our game! [u]We're still testing and refining the game[/u], so the demo may differ from the final release, and you might encounter bugs while playing. We apologize for any issues you may experience. Overall, just download it and enjoy! We hope you like it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179349/efb1d73c5a50a99d0ab602de0ba5d1095c96a78d.png[/img]

notes.title: Sped Up the Game's Pace and Adjusted Difficulty
notes.notes:
Thanks to feedback from Steam curators and Beta testing participants, we have [b]sped up the game's pace[/b]: fraud displays, evening entertainment activities, and fraud minigames now take less time. Additionally, based on the gameplay feedback we received, we have [b]adjusted the game's overall difficulty[/b], primarily focusing on the difficulty of the fraud minigames and the daily fraud performance targets, to ensure that players can experience how challenging and dreadful engaging in telecom fraud can be.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179349/69399c04c28822937710df795de038364cf4c948.png[/img]

notes.title: Fraud Skills Now Affect Fraud Minigames!
notes.notes:
Based on feedback from Steam curators and Beta test participants, we have made an update where the player's fraud skill levels now affect not only the success rates and rewards of fraud attempts but also the [b]difficulty and time cost[/b] of fraud minigames. With higher fraud skill levels, the fraud minigames will become easier and take less time. We would also like to announce that the fraud dialogues displayed after fraud minigames can be skipped by holding the [b]Space[/b] key.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179349/f2186cd2a7975823ad98cbecc825982be044f5f0.png[/img]
